### Christ Our Example
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/christ-our-example
Passage: 1 Peter 2:21-23
Points:
- Suffering for doing what is right is a vocation appointed by God rather than the product of chance.
- While fallen human nature instinctively retaliates when mistreated, the Holy Spirit equips believers to endure patiently.
- Jesus provides the ultimate model for navigating unjust suffering without retaliating or threatening His abusers.
- Christ entrusted Himself completely to the Father, resting in the confidence of His righteous judgment.
- Though a believer's suffering has no redemptive power, following Jesus in endurance serves God's sovereign plan.
